title: Can We Beat Dragonwilds’ First Dragon in Just 2 Hours?
author: SuperStooob
description:
Me and PrimitiveNomad have TWO HOURS to kill Velgar in RuneScape: Dragonwilds-starting from scratch.

AD | BerryByte affiliate link
Dragonwilds server hosting: https://berrybyte.net/a/superstooob
Use code STOOOB20 for 20% off.

Between us, we have two Golden Gnomes. Both belong to Nomad. So naturally, this should be straightforward.

Except the clock keeps running through missing materials, questionable decisions and a trip into the swamp that becomes a desperate escape. Can we get ourselves ready and defeat Dragonwilds’ first dragon before time runs out?

This is the edited adventure from our two-hour co-op challenge.

Watch PrimitiveNomad:
https://www.youtube.com/@PrimitiveNomad

Subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds challenges, hardcore adventures and tested guides.
